input_fields.name: clear_control
input_fields.description: One already calibrated empty-viewport click or Esc control.

result_fields.name: empty_selection_state
result_fields.description: Post-action empty selection and geometry-unchanged observation.

procedure: Record current selection_set and choose one calibrated clear_control.
Issue one empty-viewport click or Esc action, not both.
Observe no highlighted objects and return empty_selection_state.
If selection remains or geometry changes, stop and report mismatch.
rejection_rules: Reject a running/busy session, uncalibrated clear control, or no known initial selection.
Do not use clear selection to hide an unresolved target ambiguity.
